text:
geoff: Thinking of organizing a casual 'sundown skewers' happy hour Friday at 5:45pm near the courtyard food trucks. Kebabs, mocktails, and a 20-min mini-trivia (prizes = snack bar vouchers). Who's up? :tada: :meat_on_bone:

anya: sounds fun! I'm free but have a call until 5. I'll join right after. Can we do one quick round of 'two truths one lie' before trivia? lol

samir: count me in. Bringing a small bluetooth speaker and my terrible dad jokes. :joy:

tori: love the idea. vegetarian options? and is this ok for folks with dietary restrictions?

geoff: there are veggie skewers and a vendor that does gluten-free flatbreads. tagging ops-bot to confirm budget + whether we can buy vouchers for winners.

ops-bot: Reminder: per policy, team socials under $15 per person can be expense-submitted with "team-social" tag. Submit by Friday 11:59pm for timely reimbursement. Link: https://redwood.internal/expenses

hr-bot: FYI if you want headcount on the invite we can send a quick RSVP form and collect dietary needs. ping me to enable.

anya: Quick poll idea: reaction :hamburger: = coming in-person, :house: = remote but might pop by later, :x: = can't make it. I'll add that to the thread.

samir: :hamburger:

tori: :hamburger:

geoff: :hamburger:

anya: ok majority coming. Geoff can you confirm prize (snack vouchers) and I'll make a calendar invite with a note about dietary needs?

geoff: confirmed snack vouchers (ops-bot said $10/person ok). I'll reserve 6 vouchers for trivia winners. Also grabbing the portable whiteboard for scoring.

tori: if we have extra maybe donate one voucher to the folks on the night shift? small kindness.

samir: love that. Also remote folks: we can stream the trivia via the conference room camera for ~10 minutes so they can shout answers in thread.

geoff: good call. I'll put remote join info in the invite. See everyone Fri 5:45 (meet by courtyard truck). Low-key, quick, and fun.

hr-bot: If you collect dietary restrictions via the RSVP form, HR will compile and share with vendors to avoid issues.

anya: awesome. I'll post the RSVP poll in 5. tagging @design to see if anyone wants to make a little trivia title card. :sparkles:
